rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_ai ai_budget and ai_cost_ledger tables, drops both tables, then drops the additive nullable ai_memory.superseded_by and ai_memory.supersedes columns. ai_budget holds only tenant budget configuration and ai_cost_ledger holds derived cost provenance, so both are safe to drop; the ai_memory column drop is additive-reverse and loses only correction linkage, so on a shared environment export ai_memory first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
the northstar_ai schema with ai_memory exists (migration 000009 applied)
postchecks: ai_memory has nullable supersedes and superseded_by columns for audited memory corrections
northstar_ai schema has the ai_budget and ai_cost_ledger tables
row-level security is enabled and forced on ai_budget and ai_cost_ledger with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: GATE-AI-GA closers: multi-scope AI cost budgets + audited memory correction/export/reset
